│ ◇ Mermaid diagram (flowchart)                                                                                        │
│ flowchart TD                                                                                                         │
│   A[Decode JSON] --> B[RenderDoc]                                                                                    │
│   B --> C{Block type?}                                                                                               │
│   C -->|prose| D[wrap to width]                                                                                      │
│   C -->|rich| E[chroma / table]                                                                                      │
│   D --> F[Viewport]                                                                                                  │
│   E --> F                                                                                                            │
│ Figure 1. The render pipeline as a flow. (view in Studio)                                                            │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
                                                                                                                        
╭──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ ◇ Mermaid diagram (sequenceDiagram)                                                                                  │
│ sequenceDiagram                                                                                                      │
│   Caller->>Registry: Render(block, ctx)                                                                              │
│   Registry->>Renderer: dispatch                                                                                      │
│   Renderer-->>Caller: []string                                                                                       │
│ Figure 2. A sequence, for kind detection. (view in Studio)                                                           │
